note: Real live Drex responses captured from the running app. Replayed only when the live API is unreachable, and labelled as recorded.

subject.wafer_or_die: A wafer, die, or wafer map seen up close (microscope, inspection or AOI image)
subject.package_or_bond: A packaged part, lead frame, wire bonds, solder, or mold compound
subject.spc_or_data: A control chart, dashboard, spreadsheet, or other data screenshot
subject.wip_or_queue: Lots, carriers/FOUPs, trays, or parts waiting on shelves, carts or racks
subject.floor_or_layout: A production floor, tool layout, walking path, or material route
subject.equipment: A process tool, fixture, or machine component

defect_type.particle_contamination: Particles, residue, stains, or contamination on the surface
defect_type.pattern_or_litho: Pattern distortion, misalignment, bridging, or missing features
defect_type.crack_or_chipping: Cracks, chipping, or broken edges (die, wafer, or package)
defect_type.bond_defect: Lifted, broken, misplaced, or deformed wire bonds or solder joints
defect_type.void_or_delamination: Voids, bubbles, or delamination in mold, attach, or solder

root_waste.transportation: Material moved further than needed between tools/areas
root_waste.waiting: Lots waiting in queue at a constraint; cycle time inflated by wait, not processing
root_waste.overprocessing: More inspections or processing than the control plan requires
root_waste.overproduction: Lots built ahead of demand, then put on hold
root_waste.defects: Parameter drift, excess variation, or rising defect counts that hurt yield
root_waste.skills: Operators repeatedly overriding recipes by hand; know-how not captured in standard work

countermeasure.conwip_dbr: CONWIP / drum-buffer-rope pacing at the constraint, plus SMED on changeovers
countermeasure.recenter_spc: Re-center the off-target mean (recipe offset / calibration), then tighten SPC limits
countermeasure.doe_variation: Fishbone + designed experiment (DOE) to cut excess process variation
countermeasure.root_cause_8d: 8D root-cause containment for a defect-count spike (tool, consumable, handling)
countermeasure.sampling_plan: Replace 100% / repeated inspection with a capability-based sampling plan
countermeasure.standard_work: Kaizen with technicians; turn manual overrides into standard work and recipe updates
countermeasure.relayout_amhs: Spaghetti diagram; re-layout or batch AMHS/FOUP moves to cut transport

disposition.release: No product-quality risk; ship lots on, fix the flow problem in parallel
disposition.hold: Measured parameter is off-target or unstable; hold for engineering review before moving on
disposition.rework: Elevated defect counts that are recoverable; rework at this step
